title: What Recruiters See on Your LinkedIn
description:
Most people set up their LinkedIn profile once and forget about it. But recruiters search LinkedIn every single day using specific keywords. If your profile isn't set up the right way, you're invisible to them.

In this video, I break down exactly how recruiters search LinkedIn, which sections carry the most weight in the algorithm, and the 4 changes you can make today to start showing up in recruiter searches.

0:00 How LinkedIn Recruiter search works
2:55 Your headline (the most important line)
4:25 Your about section (tell a story, not a CV)
6:10 Your experience section (the formula)
8:30 Settings most people miss
10:50 The one change to make today
